Prompt Instructions

Before you start

  • Know your goal: what should the output do or look like?
  • Note any audience, tone, length, or format constraints.

Structure

  1. State the task clearly in one or two sentences.
  2. Give context: background info, examples, or data the model needs.
  3. Specify the output format (list, table, code, JSON, etc.).
  4. List constraints or things to avoid.

Refine

  • Test the prompt, then tighten wording based on the result.
  • Break multi-step tasks into smaller, ordered instructions.
